title: Add OAuth2 public client resource
description:
## Summary

Add a new `kanidm_oauth2_public` Terraform resource for managing OAuth2 public (PKCE-only) clients in Kanidm. Public clients are used for SPAs, native apps, and mobile apps that cannot securely store a client secret.

## Context

The provider already has `kanidm_oauth2_basic` for confidential clients. The API client layer (`internal/client/oauth2.go`) already implements `CreateOAuth2PublicClient()` and all shared operations (Get, Update, Delete, ScopeMap management) work for both client types. The `OAuth2Client` struct includes an `IsPublic` flag for type detection.

## Scope

- New resource file: `internal/provider/oauth2_public_resource.go`
- Register `NewOAuth2PublicResource` in `provider.go`
- Schema: `name` (required, immutable), `displayname` (required), `origin` (required), `redirect_uris` (optional), `scope_map` (optional block)
- No `client_secret` attribute (public clients don't have secrets)
- CRUD operations mirroring `oauth2_basic` minus secret handling
- Import support via resource name
- Type verification in Read: error if retrieved client is not public
- Unit and acceptance tests

## Key Differences from oauth2_basic

| Aspect | Basic | Public |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Create endpoint | `POST /v1/oauth2/_basic` | `POST /v1/oauth2/_public` |
| Client secret | Yes (computed, sensitive) | None |
| PKCE | Optional | Mandatory (enforced by Kanidm) |
| Use case | Server-side apps | SPAs, native/mobile apps |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `kanidm_oauth2_public` resource is available in the provider
- [ ] Create, Read, Update, Delete operations work correctly
- [ ] Scope maps can be configured and updated
- [ ] `terraform import` works using the client name
- [ ] Read operation errors if the client is not a public type
- [ ] Provider documentation is generated via `make docs`
- [ ] All tests pass (`make test`, `make testacc`)
